key_findings: Three-day continuous intrathecal oxytocin infusion after pSNL attenuated mechanical and thermal hypersensitivity for 14 days via spinal Oxtr, while a single injection gave only ~30 min analgesia.

Continuous oxytocin restored nerve injury-reduced spinal KCC2 mRNA/protein and normalized the depolarized ECl- in dorsal horn neurons; acute OT depolarized vGAT+ interneurons and enhanced GABAergic sIPSCs.
